# Open Film Skills

Repository: https://github.com/62656456/ai-film-skills

Purpose: reusable Skills for AI film writing, directing, asset definition, visual language, storyboard design, production, web design, and source-backed research.

Primary entry points:
- skills/director-agent/SKILL.md
- skills/ai-storyboard-director/SKILL.md
- skills/character-asset/SKILL.md
- skills/scene-asset/SKILL.md
- skills/prop-asset/SKILL.md
- skills/produce-ai-video/SKILL.md
- SKILL_CATALOG.md

Status rule: do not describe packaged or experimental Skills as production-stable. Do not restore retired Skills. Read each selected SKILL.md completely before use, then load only the references it explicitly requires.
